_comment: Advisories accepted after review. Each entry expires; the CI audit gate fails on anything new at high/critical, and on any entry past its expiry, so these get re-checked. Reviewed 2026-10-06.

advisories.reason: Build-time file watcher only, patterns come from our own config. No patched release exists (latest 3.0.3 is affected).
Used by the Expo CLI for dev code-signing certificates; never bundled into the app and never verifies third-party signatures at runtime. No patched release exists.

Ships to the browser but only decodes the viewer's own URL (worst case: the viewer's own tab hangs on a crafted link). The fixed 0.5 is ESM-only and breaks query-string@7; resolve when expo-router upgrades query-string.
